content.text:
The site looked different because the custom font stopped loading. `site/css/tokens.css` pointed the `@font-face` rule at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the folder is `site/fonts/`. The browser got a 404 and every page fell back to the system font.

I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. The server now returns 200 for the font file, and all 16 functional tests pass. I haven't looked at the pages in a browser. The tests check behavior, not appearance.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see which change introduced the typo. I found it by reading the CSS. The untracked `.idea` and `.vscode` entries are unrelated, and I left them alone.

STATUS: DONE
